description.value: Old Man Pho is a Vietnamese restaurant in Powell River serving authentic pho, vermicelli bowls, rice plates, spring rolls, and street food favorites made with fresh ingredients and traditional flavors. The menu is broad and spans appetizers, skewers, curries, and desserts, with a dedicated vegetarian section. Situated on Highway 101 (the Sunshine Coast Highway), it is a natural and substantial meal stop for cyclists riding the Sunshine Coast route.

address.value: Unit B - 9398 101 Highway, Powell River, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: phone (604) 487-1997 matches OSM +16044871997, the address resolves to the same location (BC Highway 101 is also called the Sunshine Coast Highway), and the restaurant is confirmed open Monday–Sunday. The menu subpage lists a dedicated VEGETARIAN section, providing positive evidence for dietary options. OSM carries internet_access=wlan, but the website makes no mention of Wi-Fi, so that claim is left unconfirmed per the rules.
concerns: OSM street is listed as 'Sunshine Coast Highway' while the website uses '101 Highway' — these refer to the same road (BC Highway 101), so no functional discrepancy, but the OSM street name could be harmonized for consistency.

OSM community is classified as 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Powell River is on the BC mainland (Sunshine Coast region), not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands — community classification likely needs correction.
